title: Orsen and the Undertow
author: O. M. Delacroix
blurb: Yara Iversen, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the demolition date arrives.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
